items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Lou Donaldson was another one I worked with just briefly before Dizzy.

ctx.x: Your apprenticeship was top drawer, a launching pad.
Yeah, I feel very blessed to have had those experiences. Lou Donaldson was another one I worked with just briefly before Dizzy.
